title: India vs Pakistan: who is richer? 3 rounds, real data
headline: India or *Pakistan*?
description: India or Pakistan: who is richer, who lives longer, and who lives in cities? Three rounds of real World Bank data. How many did you get right?
source: World Bank: GDP per person (2025), life expectancy at birth (2024), urban population share (2025), data.worldbank.org

segments.text: India or Pakistan. Three rounds. Who is richer per person?
Round two. Who lives longer? India or Pakistan?
India again. Over four years longer.
Final round. More people in cities? India or Pakistan?
Pakistan. Almost forty percent live in cities.
So who really wins, India or Pakistan?
